disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining an abandoned apiary or bee equipment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for a person to knowingly maintain an abandoned apiary or bee equipment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transporting bees or used equipment into West Virginia without a certificate of inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to transport bees, used bee equipment or used appliances into West Virginia, unless accompanied by a certificate of inspection signed by an authorized state or federal inspection official

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obstructing or hindering the commissioner in the discharge of duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall obstruct or hinder the commissioner in the discharge of his or her duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Shipping, selling, or giving away bees or equipment from an apiary where honey bee pests have been found until pests are controlled
disciplinary_grounds.quote: it shall be unlawful for the owner or operator to ship, sell or give away any queen bees, appliances, packaged bees, full colonies or nuclei colonies from the apiary until the honey bee pests have been controlled to the satisfaction of the commissioner.

definition_quote.value: Apiary means any place where one or more colonies or nuclei of bees are kept or where bee equipment is stored.
definition_quote.quote: Apiary means any place where one or more colonies or nuclei of bees are kept or where bee equipment is stored.

registration_required.quote: All persons keeping bees in this state shall apply for a certificate of registration for beekeeping from the commissioner, within ten days of the date that bees are acquired

apiary_identification_required.quote: All persons owning or operating an apiary which is not located on their own property must post the name and address of the owner or operator in a conspicuous place in the apiary.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: notifying the commissioner, in writing, of the number and location of colonies they own or rent, or which they keep for someone else

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: notifying the commissioner, in writing, of the number and location of colonies they own or rent, or which they keep for someone else, whether the bees are located on their own property or someone else's property

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: It shall be unlawful for a person to knowingly maintain an abandoned apiary or bee equipment.

import_permit_required.quote: Prior to the movement of any bees, used bee equipment or used appliances into West Virginia, and as a prerequisite to the issuance of a permit of entry, the commissioner shall be furnished by the owner, transporter, or operator

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to transport bees, used bee equipment or used appliances into West Virginia, unless accompanied by a certificate of inspection signed by an authorized state or federal inspection official verifying the actual inspection of the bees, used bee equipment or used appliances

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: verifying the actual inspection of the bees, used bee equipment or used appliances within thirty days preceding the date of shipment

regulated_diseases.quote: Honey bee pest means American foulbrood (Bacillus larvae), European foulbrood (Melissococcus pluton), Varroa mite (Varroa destructor), honey bee tracheal mite (Acarapis woodi), or any other virus or infectious or parasitic organism determined by the commissioner

quarantine_authority.quote: The commissioner shall quarantine all apiaries, bees, bee equipment, bee products, appliances and premises infected by honey bee pests.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: During reasonable working hours, the commissioner may enter upon any premises to access any apiary for the purpose of inspecting or sampling.

queen_rearing_apiary_certification_requi.quote: All apiaries producing queens, packaged bees or nuclei colonies for distribution shall be inspected each year.

voluntary_beekeeper_education_program.quote: The commissioner is authorized to conduct apiary education in a manner which advances and promotes bee culture in West Virginia.

beekeeper_civil_liability_limitation.quote: A person who: (1) Owns and operates an apiary; (2) Is registered with the commissioner; and (3) Operates the apiary in a reasonable manner and in conformance with the West Virginia Department of Agriculture's written best management practices provided by rule, is not liable for any personal injury or property damage that occurs in connection with the keeping and maintaining of bees
